faq: What if the plot is not square?
Area alone cannot give a non-square perimeter (shape matters). For rectangles, one side plus area fixes everything — the rectangular tools take it from there.

Why is my fence longer than this on a slope?
Fences follow the ground; area is plan measure. Sloped boundaries run long — the calculator gives the plan perimeter the deed would recognise.
The side is shown to a decimal; fencing orders round up to the next roll or panel — buy by the perimeter plus waste, as every trade does.
A circle of equal area has about 11% less perimeter — the isoperimetric fact. Circular plots are their own tools' business.
